sum: Indexes a repository into a code graph that stays in sync with the files, so an agent asks the graph instead of reading its way there. Local, and reachable over MCP from nine harnesses.

evidence.se.residency: cites data_residency: local-first, the operator's state stays on their machine
evidence.se.threats: cites th and ctrl: T2 introduced, controls log part
evidence.fx.exit: artifact.format store: a store the tool owns; what survives removal depends on an export path
evidence.sf.reach: restates exec, ctrl and data_residency: the entry does not execute code itself and keeps its state local, so there is no unattended reach for a control to bound
evidence.pe.budget: a ceiling the operator sets on the command line: README.md (--max-depth)
evidence.co.coexist: states the hosts it sits beside: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, JetBrains (README.md)
evidence.ic.help: a command-line parser that prints its own usage: package.json (commander)
evidence.ic.error: a confirmation step in the code path: src/installer/index.ts (--yes)
evidence.rl.resume: a checkpoint or restore path in the code: src/index.ts (checkpointing)
evidence.se.attest: signs or attests what it publishes: .github/workflows/release.yml (Sigstore)
evidence.fx.install: an install that does not change the machine globally: README.md (npx @)
evidence.fx.byo: the entry does not call a model provider itself, so there is no provider for the operator to substitute
evidence.sf.stop: a stop path, and the state it leaves behind is described: src/index.ts (AbortSignal); src/index.ts (checkpointing)
evidence.co.standards: cites standards_conformance.evidence: conforms to 1 of the 5 neutral interface standards (AGENTS.md)

pre: a supported language and a repository large enough that reading it is the cost
an index that can be kept in sync
anti: small repositories, where the index costs more than the reading it saves
gnote: Reduces tokens by answering structural questions from an index rather than by making the agent read files, which is the same move the output compressors make on the other side of the tool call. Hosted product announced, so the boundary of the MIT part is worth watching.

ja.sum: リポジトリをコードグラフとして索引し、ファイルの変更に追随させる。エージェントは読み進める代わりにグラフに問う。ローカルで動き、9つのハーネスからMCPで到達できる。
ja.art: 事前索引されたコードグラフ（永続）
pre: 対応言語と、読むこと自体が費用になる規模のリポジトリ
同期を維持できる索引
anti: 小さなリポジトリ。索引のほうが、省ける読解より高くつく
ja.gnote: 構造的な問いを索引から答えることでトークンを減らす。これはツール呼び出しの反対側で出力圧縮器がやっているのと同じ手である。ホスト版製品が予告されており、MITの範囲は注視に値する。

steps: エージェントがグラフに問う
